statement: The frozen V6.6 actor-local geometry head retains threshold-free ranking signal on a V6.7 task-untouched six-scene legacy cohort, enabling a fixed-budget ray-terminated surface audit.
The P1 scores can be baked into an Actor-preserving package and matched fixed-budget action set without target fields, Actor removal or hazard-conditioned existence.
A fixed 50% learned local-action budget preserves all Actors and hazard proxies while handling at least half of task-untouched local conflicts.
Intersecting same-Actor one-voxel support with source behind-hit ray termination preserves at least 40% clean geometry while removing at least 50% target conflicts under the unchanged P3 action set.

A target-frame inward half-ball behind each nearest motion-compensated same-Actor hit preserves at least 40% clean geometry while removing at least 50% target conflicts under the unchanged P3 actions and gates.
The frozen V6.6 local geometry head transfers without refit to a second surface-task-independent legacy cohort, enabling a fully frozen package/action/inward-ray confirmation chain.
The P5 canonical scores can be baked into a complete Actor-preserving package without target fields, Actor removal or hazard-conditioned existence.
The fixed 50% learned local-action budget preserves all Actors and hazard proxies while handling at least half of independent legacy local conflicts.
The exact P4R motion-compensated inward-ray rule passes all nine physical-repair gates on the independent legacy confirmation cohort under the frozen P7 L0 actions.
The frozen head-package-action-inward-ray chain passes unchanged on a repository-unmentioned and previously unprocessed six-scene cohort.
The frozen V6.6 local geometry head transfers without refit to the new P9 fresh cohort and enables the unchanged physical confirmation chain.
P10 fresh scores bake into a complete Actor-preserving package without target fields, removal or hazard-conditioned existence.
The frozen learned arm handles at least half of fresh conflict states at the unchanged 50-percent budget while preserving every Actor and hazard attribute.

The exact motion-compensated one-voxel inward-ray rule reduces at least half of fresh conflict points while retaining at least 40 percent overall and clean boundaries and preserving all Actor contracts.

A differentiable residual field over native boundary and target-free directional geometry rescues clean points beyond the frozen inward-ray core while preserving at least 50 percent conflict reduction on one consumed selection cohort.

A rescue threshold calibrated only from leave-one-training-scene-out conflict scores controls selection conflict rescue while retaining a measurable clean rescue on the exact action-eligible denominator.

Conditioning on a fixed Ego trajectory and its visited world-state aggregate predicts two-second expected hidden-FREE cost more usefully than voxel correctness, improving bottom-quartile action reliability over qmean on one consumed selection cohort.
A case-centered action-lattice residual bounded by the meaningful cost gap preserves qmean cross-cohort ranking while learning transferable trajectory-specific visited-state corrections.
A bounded trajectory reliability adapter trained across both consumed action domains transfers without refit to fresh P9 candidate-action visited-state costs after the model is frozen.

Keeping qmean action ranking frozen while learning a monotone case-level benefit head can identify the fixed half of cases where bottom-quartile action authority improves visited-state cost, otherwise abstaining.
The frozen P18 compiler retains its selective qmean authority benefit on an independent six-scene legacy cohort without refit or coverage changes.
A four-domain bounded residual trained with differentiable bottom-quartile listwise cost improves action selection over frozen qmean on an action-task-untouched cohort.
Selective authority trained over the frozen P20 ranking yields a stronger fixed-coverage action-set benefit on an action-task-untouched cohort.
Adding a fixed selected unsafe-event loss to six-domain listwise training improves tail-risk proxy reduction over the mean-only P20 compiler on an action-task-untouched eight-scene cohort.
A continuous entropic selected-cost objective avoids the binary tail barrier and reduces selected top-tail cost over P20 on an action-task-untouched cohort.
A bounded cross-case offset allocates the exact fixed total action budget more effectively than uniform per-case P20 selection while preserving P20 within-case order.
At exactly the fixed total action budget, allowing abstention while enforcing at least half-case coverage improves selected cost over fixed P20 and min-one P24 allocation.

The coverage-constrained exact-total allocator, retrained on ten development domains, transfers to a larger 16-scene stratum-balanced visited-state cohort without changing its architecture or allocation contract.
An exact-total allocator can preserve at least half-case authority separately in night, rain, construction, and vulnerable-transit strata while retaining selected-cost benefit.
A single allocator conditioned at 0.25 and 0.50 action fractions interpolates to a held-out one-third budget while retaining exact-total and per-stratum coverage constraints.
Quarter-budget authority can be extended to a half-budget authority set with exact totals, strict set nesting, per-group coverage, and retained selected-cost benefit.
A case authority compiler trained with one- and two-second horizon conditions interpolates to held-out H=1.5 seconds for Ego-trajectory visited-state reliability.
A single compiler jointly conditioned on action budget and future horizon transfers to the unseen pair (one-third budget, H=1.5 seconds).
The joint budget-horizon authority family transfers at (one-third,H=1.5s) to a second task-condition-untouched legacy cohort.
A bounded aleatoric case-offset scale tracks realized offset error and a fixed mean-plus-one-scale conservative priority improves selected cost over the joint mean compiler.
A fixed three-member joint-condition ensemble provides model disagreement that tracks mean error and mean-plus-one-disagreement improves consumed P4C selection over the frozen P33 mean compiler.
A budget-horizon-conditioned action scorer trained by differentiable top-k target cost improves unseen-condition consumed selection over the frozen case-offset compiler.
The frozen P36 conditioned action scorer retains decision gain over the frozen joint case-offset compiler on a second consumed cohort.
Smooth worst-domain aggregation of conditioned soft top-k losses improves cross-cohort P10X selection over the frozen joint compiler.
Expanding development cohort and budget diversity while keeping the P36 objective fixed improves target-untouched third-cohort selection over the frozen joint compiler.
The frozen expanded-domain action compiler retains decision gain on a fourth action-target-untouched but globally consumed cohort.
A terminal eight-domain ERM-style conditioned action compiler gains over the frozen joint compiler on action-target-untouched P10R2.
Composing frozen P31 case allocation with a trained case-centered refinement over frozen P20 improves target-untouched P6R selection.
The frozen hybrid preserves exact strict nesting and nonregression versus P31 at quarter and half budgets.
Anchoring hybrid action residuals to zero at quarter budget preserves the low-resource baseline while retaining one-third-budget gain on a new H=1.5 task condition.
The frozen anchored hybrid preserves exact nesting and P31 nonregression at quarter and half budgets on the new H=1.5 condition.
Adding P6R H=1.5 development preserves anchored-hybrid gain on newly materialized P10R4 H=1.5 at one-third budget.
The frozen cross-cohort anchored hybrid replicates exact strict nested nonregression at quarter and half budgets.
A residual adapter anchored to frozen P20 at both quarter and half budgets preserves endpoints while improving one-third selection on newly materialized P10R2 H=1.5.
A fixed final-layer domain-gradient direction consistency penalty improves the endpoint-preserving interior adapter on newly materialized P3C H=1.5.
The frozen P49 hybrid preserves its decision gain on independently materialized P2V H=1.5 without training or refit.
The unchanged gradient-consistent hybrid scales to a newly materialized 16-scene P6E H=1.5 condition after adding P2V H=1.5 development.
Training at two active interior budgets enables the gradient-consistent hybrid to generalize to jointly unseen budget .375 and below-range horizon .8s.
Fixed averaging of the final 20 percent of the P53 training trajectory improves a same-read frozen P53 baseline on P10R4 budget .375 and H=.8s.
Standard SAM at fixed radius .05 improves the P53 gradient hybrid in a same-read P10R2 budget .375 and H=.8s comparison.
A differentiable case gate selectively suppresses the residual expert and improves both frozen P53 and P31 on P6R budget .375 and H=.8s.
A query-conditioned MLP predicts exposure-weighted Actor constant-velocity extrapolation error better than an equal-capacity Actor-only MLP on unseen scenes and unseen H=2.0 seconds.
One fixed pairwise term restores query-conditioned ranking above the equal-capacity Actor-only baseline while retaining P60 MAE and unreliable-event gates.
A train-only positive-slope affine map preserves P61 ranking and AUROC while restoring at least ten percent MAE gain over Actor-only on a third development scene split.
Rank-contrastive pretraining of the query representation followed by a frozen-encoder regression head improves both ranking and MAE over Actor-only on a fourth development scene split.
The exact P60 plain-Huber query model repeats its MAE and unreliable-event support on the fifth development scene split at unseen H=2.0.
An ordered q10/q50/q90 query head retains P60 reliability performance and obtains 75-85 percent central interval coverage at unseen H=2.5 seconds.
The exact P60 plain-Huber model retains its three gates on the exact P65 scenes at H=2.5, isolating P65 failure to the quantile head and loss.
A direct binary query head improves exposed Actor-state unreliability AUROC over both the continuous query score and an Actor-only binary head at H=2.5.
